Class ParsleyConfig

java.lang.Object
io.github.tobyjamesclements.parsley.api.ParsleyConfig
public final class ParsleyConfig extends Object
Broker connection, application identity and the tuning Parsley leaves open.

Configuration that carries the delivery guarantee is fixed by the runtime and cannot be set here. ParsleyConfig.Builder.streamsProperty(String, Object) rejects those keys rather than silently ignoring them, so a configuration that would weaken the guarantee fails at construction.

    • builder

      public static ParsleyConfig.Builder builder(String bootstrapServers, String applicationIdPrefix)
      Begins a configuration.
      Parameters:
      bootstrapServers - Kafka bootstrap servers
      applicationIdPrefix - prefix for each process's Kafka application id, which identifies its committed state across restarts
      Returns:
      a builder
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if bootstrapServers is null or blank, or applicationIdPrefix does not satisfy Kafka's topic-name rule or contains the reserved Store.RESERVED_PREFIX namespace, since it prefixes application ids and changelog topic names
